-- No bad block at height 3 for top-window components
-- This should follow from finite case analysis on the slot structure

def TopWindow (C : Finset ℕ) (q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ r ∈ C, q / 2 < r ∧ r < q

def Block (q j : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  Finset.Icc ((j - 1) * q + 1) (j * q)

noncomputable def Slot (q j r : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Block q j).filter fun t => ¬(q ∣ t) ∧ r ∣ t

noncomputable def BlockCov (C : Finset ℕ) (q j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ((Block q j).filter fun t => ¬(q ∣ t) ∧ ∃ r ∈ C, r ∣ t).card

noncomputable def SlotMass (C : Finset ℕ) (q j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ r ∈ C, (Slot q j r).card

def BadBlock (C : Finset ℕ) (q j : ℕ) : Prop :=
  2 * BlockCov C q j < SlotMass C q j

-- At height 3, block is (2q, 3q]. Each r > q/2 has multiples 2r and (maybe) 3r in this block.
-- Since r > q/2, we have 2r > q and 3r > 3q/2. Also 2r < 2q and 3r < 3q.
-- So 2r ∈ (q, 2q) ⊂ block 2, and 3r ∈ (3q/2, 3q) which IS in block 3.
-- Each r contributes at most slot {3r} (if q ∤ 3r) to block 3.
-- So SlotMass ≤ |C| and BlockCov = |union of {3r : r ∈ C, q ∤ 3r}|.
-- For BadBlock we need 2*BlockCov < SlotMass ≤ |C|.
-- But BlockCov ≥ 1 if any slot is nonempty, giving 2 ≤ 2*BlockCov.
-- And if SlotMass ≤ |C| then we need 2*BlockCov < |C|.

-- Actually wait: at height 3, each r has multiples 3r in (2q, 3q].
-- Since r > q/2, 3r > 3q/2 > 2q ✓. And r < q, so 3r < 3q ✓.
-- So each r contributes EXACTLY one multiple (3r) to block 3 (if q ∤ 3r).
-- SlotMass = #{r ∈ C : q ∤ 3r}.
-- BlockCov = #{distinct values 3r : r ∈ C, q ∤ 3r}.
-- But 3r₁ = 3r₂ iff r₁ = r₂, so BlockCov = SlotMass.
-- Then 2*BlockCov < SlotMass becomes 2*SlotMass < SlotMass, i.e. SlotMass < 0. Contradiction!

-- Hmm, but Slot also includes 2r if 2r ∈ (2q, 3q]. Since r > q/2, 2r > q.
-- For 2r to be in block 3, need 2r > 2q, i.e. r > q. But r < q. So 2r < 2q.
-- Therefore 2r is NOT in block 3. Only 3r is.

-- So the proof should be: at height 3, SlotMass = BlockCov, so BadBlock is impossible.

theorem no_bad_block_height_three (C : Finset ℕ) (q : ℕ)
    (hTop : TopWindow C q) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ¬ BadBlock C q 3 := by
  sorry
